name: JSON to Code
description: Generate TypeScript, Rust, Go, Java, Kotlin, Python and C# types from a JSON sample
help: Paste a JSON sample; nested objects become named types and array items are merged into one type.
Fields missing from some array items become optional; null values make a field nullable; mixed values fall back to the language's “any” type.
Field names follow each language's conventions, with rename annotations (serde, JSON tags, Jackson, kotlinx, pydantic, System.Text.Json) wherever the JSON key differs.
Everything is generated locally in Rust.
